entities.name: Battle of Bir Hakeim
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The Battle of Bir Hakeim was a pivotal battle fought between German and Italian forces and the Free French Forces led by General Marie-Pierre Kœnig. 

Fought from June 9 to 11, 1942, during the North African Campaign of World War II, the battle took place in Bir Hakeim, a strategic location in the Libyan Desert. 

The battle was significant because it delayed the Axis advance and allowed the Allied forces to prepare for the Second Battle of El Alamein, which ultimately led to the defeat of the Axis powers in North Africa. 

As General Kœnig said, 'Bir Hakeim will be a symbol of our resistance and our tenacity.'
